<b>Mites</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Mites|pests]] that are common in the dark corners of [[Greymoor]].<ref>Mite [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Verminous pest, common throughout the dark corners of Greymoor."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Mites run back and forth along the ground, or cling to walls. When Hornet approaches, Mites scream before leaping at her, dealing {{Damage|1}} on contact. They can be kept at bay with jumps and knockback from Needle strikes. In underground areas of Greymoor, they can get caught in claw traps that defeat them instantly.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Mites have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2|
* Smell it, starving...
* Deeper, darker...
* Shriek and scratch them...
* Claw and fang...
* Find it. Take it...
* Hide below them...
}}

== Location ==
Mites can be found in [[Greymoor]] and [[Sinner's Road]]. Four of them are located in the cellar of [[Halfway Home]], an area that becomes inaccessible after completing the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 4|enemy gauntlet]] that takes place there.
